output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow that allows users to transfer balances of zero.
The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow that allows users to transfer balances of zero.
The 'transferFrom' function uses a predictable value for 'msg.sender' in the 'transferFrom' function, allowing attackers to gain control over assets.
The 'disableToken' function allows the owner to disable token transfers, but it does not verify the transfer amount, allowing attackers to disable token transfers for a specific user.
